data.title: 五河琴里 · 晨光沙发珊瑚绒连帽衫的娇懒卷曲
data.description: 清晨阳光洒在客厅沙发上，琴里裹在宽大的粉红猫耳珊瑚绒长卫衣中，光洁小腿蜷缩在沙发上，揉着惺忪睡眼小口打着哈欠。
data.action: 双腿蜷在沙发垫上，两只手缩在长长的卫衣袖子口里揉眼睛，小嘴微张打哈欠
data.lighting: 温润初升朝阳照亮漂浮微尘，珊瑚绒面料泛着毛茸茸的高光
data.camera: 近景平视，极致展现娇憨依恋的私密生活感
data.promptProse: Kotori Itsuka curls lazily on the wide living room sofa in the quiet early morning, wrapped in an oversized plush pastel pink hoodie with cat-ear hood details. With her slender bare legs tucked close beneath the fleece and extra-long sleeves engulfing her hands, she rubs her sleepy crimson eyes and gives a tiny, unguarded yawn as warm dawn sunlight floods across the cushions.
data.animaCaption: Bundled up in a fluffy oversized hoodie, Kotori curls on the morning couch rubbing her sleepy eyes with a small yawn.
